description:
JMAP-qz9v.17 added `debug_assert!(!account_id.is_empty(), ...)` to crate-jmap-contacts-server's MemoryBackend::register_account (and the contacts-specific with_account convenience). The canonical jmap-mail-server (crate-jmap-mail-server/src/memory/mod.rs:292) and other extension-server siblings have the same gap.

Mail-server takes `&Id` (no internal Id::from call), so the gap is reachable via callers who pass an empty Id externally — same latent bug, slightly different exposure surface.

Propagation needed across:
- crate-jmap-mail-server (canonical)
- crate-jmap-chat-server
- crate-jmap-calendars-server
- crate-jmap-tasks-server
- crate-jmap-filenode-server
- crate-jmap-sharing-server
- crate-jmap-metadata-server

Mechanical: add `debug_assert!(!account_id.as_ref().is_empty(), "register_account: account_id must not be the empty string")` at the top of each MemoryBackend::register_account. P3 because the surface is test-only (`feature = "memory"`) and debug-only (the assert is removed in release).
title: Workspace sweep: add empty-id debug_assert on MemoryBackend::register_account across extension-server siblings
